verdict.summary: 81 zero-parameter / structural portfolio overlays across 3 multi-leg panels. Not one clears its panel's size-matched placebo p95 for max dSharpe(holdout). In every panel the observed max is at or below the MEAN of the null-max distribution, and the MEDIAN overlay is negative. Plain equal-risk 1/N on design-vol-scaled legs is the winner.
actionable_negatives: OV_T13_SPYVOL: the SPY vol overlay currently FROZEN in BASKET_FORWARD_FROZEN.json costs the combined market-neutral book -0.03/-0.22/-0.19 holdout Sharpe and -0.05/-0.31/-0.31 full-window Sharpe across the three panels. It never helps. ESCALATE.
OV_EQDOLLAR: equal-DOLLAR is -0.97/-0.39/-1.10 holdout vs equal-RISK. The design-vol scaling in the base is load-bearing.
OV_RP60/RP120/RP60_CAP40: trailing-vol risk parity is -0.43/-0.37 holdout on the 5-leg panel. Replicates R3's 'the more the weights learn, the worse they travel' on a fresh panel and a fresh leg set.
OV_DROP_MOSTCORR120: -0.13/-0.31/-0.81. Dropping the most-correlated leg is harmful in all three panels.
leg_escalations: L2 ETFRV FAILS the rho1 bounce gate (-0.44..-0.50 on all five pairs vs the -0.35 threshold) AND fails the shared-price placebo. Signal and fill are both the 15:45 print. GROSS: +1.295 bp t +17.95 at a 15:45 fill -> +0.076 bp t +1.05 at a 15:50 fill; 94% of gross edge evaporates in 5 minutes. NET flips +0.10 bp/SR 0.74 -> -1.12 bp/t -15.4/SR -8.0. Clears any gross bar and is still fake. RECOMMEND DEMOTE TO UNSIZED.

L3 DUALCLASS survives a one-day-gap re-entry but at half size: 50.1 bp t 6.54 -> 23.7 bp t 3.59 (gap 1), 20.0 bp t 3.07 (gap 2). Real but half the headline is same-close bounce. BRK.A/BRK.B has rho1 -0.459 (fails the gate) and should be dropped from the pair list; the other 15 pairs pass (-0.13..-0.34).
